cases.title: a3: Explain the panel error-rate-by-service.
cases.input: Explain the panel error-rate-by-service.

trials.output: This panel measures the proportion of failed HTTP requests per service over a one-minute window, where a rise indicates an increase in server errors. It is computed by dividing the rate of server error responses by the total request rate for each service. For peak overall values, check Error rate · peak.
